question: Can the isolated per-hash transaction keep failure atomicity while carrying materially less metadata than Candidate-shaped staging?
mechanism: Sparse per-hash overlay with lazy hint and Deflate fields. Existing hashes retain no staged raw bytes; one hint stays scalar until a second distinct hint requires a set; Deflate maps are allocated only when observed.

cpu_microcourt.interpretation: Duplicate-only callback bookkeeping is slower but sub-millisecond; unique-heavy paths are materially faster in this Python court. Complete product wall remains unmeasured.

decision: ADVANCE_SPARSE_OVERLAY_AS_THE_STRONGER PRODUCT IMPLEMENTATION SHAPE. It preserves the isolated transaction invariant and exhaustive add_content semantics while materially reducing unique-hash metadata. Candidate-shaped staging becomes the simpler reference control. Raw event logging remains rejected because event-count memory explodes on duplicate-heavy callbacks; rollback journaling remains a fallback only if same-source product RSS rejects isolated staging.

productization_status.next: Land the sparse Builder overlay plus focused success/failure/order/object-identity tests when the ordinary source-write surface is available, then measure same-source archive/tree/wall/process-RSS before promotion.
